rules.name: No evidence, no claim
rules.description: Completion or repair claims must be backed by concrete evidence from tool output in the same task window.

rules.name: 复杂任务先探索与方案收敛
rules.description: Complex/multistep/ambiguous tasks should show exploration, plan, assumptions or acceptance criteria before implementation.

rules.name: 失败后禁止无新信息重复操作
rules.description: Repeated failures must collect new information or switch strategy instead of retrying the same action blindly.
